description: This Java class provides utility methods for handling exceptions in the context of implementing Hono-specific authentication handlers, particularly processing exceptions during device authentication attempts.

classes.name: AuthHandlerTools
classes.description: A utility class with static methods for processing exceptions related to authentication in Hono's web services.

methods.name: processException
methods.description: Handles exceptions during device authentication, determining the appropriate HTTP response or failure based on exception type and root cause.
